additional_info.subject: Laden nicht möglich EVSE-ID: 216878
additional_info.body:
Hallo zusammen,
Mein Name ist Benjamin Perske und ich arbeite für die Firma AKKODIS DCE an einem Ladeinfrastrukturprojekt für die Firma BMW.
Leider an einer ihrer Säulen nicht geladen werden, da nur ein statischer Pilot erkannt wurde.
Es handelt sich um folgende Säule:
ID: 216878
Standort: Maria-Probst-straße 6 80939 München
Zeitpunkt: 14.01.2025 09:55 Uhr
Gibt es hier bekannte Probleme mit der Säule bzw. könnten sie sich den Fall bitte einmal ansehen?
Ich danke bereits für eine Rückmeldung.
Viele Grüße
Benjamin Perske
Benjamin Perske
Digital Engineer Consultant E-Mobility & Powertrain Leipzig (DCE)

additional_info.subject: AWS Query: Session Failing on DC1 during cable check
additional_info.body: There were 60 failed sessions on this unit in the last two weeks during the "Cable Check," with 54 occurring on the DC1 outlet.

additional_info.subject: Note to ES
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
NA
Problem Description:
Customer experienced multiple failed charging sessions on outlet DC1 (
EVSE-ID: 216878
).
Action Performed (L2):
I checked the logs for the provided timestamp and noticed that all sessions failed due to a cable check timeout. The summary is attached in the note below. Additionally, I verified the AWS logs and found that there were 60 failed sessions on this unit in the last two weeks during the "Cable Check," with 54 failures occurring on the DC1 outlet. The AWS query screenshot is also attached in the note below.
Charger SW Version:
v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further investigation.
Fault history:
NA
Log analysis with timestamp:
05 Feb 2025, from 11:40 AM to 12:10 PM (UTC). Also attached the logs.
Action Required by HQ:
Further investigation.
